Frozen OpenD baseline pack v2 with prediction_coupled_simulator=true reports coupling_observation trade_intents=0, fills=0, turnover=0 for the same no-trade strategy on the five-session AAPL OpenD corpus.
findings.LIMITATION: HIGH confidence in recorded counters from frozen manifests; comparison spans different corpora (fixture EFCC71DF… vs OpenD 355FDBB…). This documents simulator/predictor alignment machinery, not tradable edge.
findings.POSSIBLE_CAUSE: Prediction-conditioned simulator gating (PR #266) stops bar-path replay fills when the strategy emits no trade intents; v1 harness replayed bar-path events independent of predictor abstention.
findings.REQUIRED_DATA: None for closure; optional regression trace comparing v1 vs v2 harness flags on a single corpus in a future engineering experiment.
